title: Fraud-Aware Synthetic Data Generation (FA-GAN)
summary: A research framework for generating fraud-aware synthetic financial transaction data to counter extreme class imbalance in fraud detection, introducing a custom FA-GAN with a Pattern-Preserving Loss and an F-cKS evaluation metric. Its synthetic_generators.py module also instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer as comparison generators alongside the custom model.
evidence: src/synthetic_generators.py:49-132 imports CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer from sdv.single_table and fits/generates data
needs: Unclear whether these SDV generators appear in the reported results table (only SMOTE/FA-SMOTE/GMM shown) or are used only internally for comparison.
